dedupe_keys.name: storage emissions transparent framework for assessing the emission impact of battery storage dispatch

description: Enzo Diependaal and colleagues publish storage-emissions, Python code that reconstructs an hourly marginal emission intensity from public market inputs and compares battery-dispatch rules. Zenodo and the linked repository identify Apache 2.0 code. The Netherlands case uses 2018–2025 day-ahead prices, a plant stack and fuel and carbon prices to compare greedy, profit, emission and lexicographic strategies for a 1 MW, 2 MWh battery. A configuration can be adapted to another bidding zone for dispatch simulation. No catalogue record explicitly covers this dispatch and emission trade-off model. A limitation is that three commodity-price series are licensed and absent from the repository; the README gives reconstruction and checking instructions. Marginal emission estimates depend on the plant stack and market assumptions, and reported outputs were not verified here. The code was not installed or run; the archived release and current repository may differ.
